retrieval.round_expansion: selected turn plus its next turn

reader.prompt_source: official upstream run_generation.py at pinned revision

judge.prompt_source: official task-specific prompts in evaluate_qa.py at pinned revision

decision_rule.support: The complete 500-case run validates, retrieval is frozen before labels are opened, every provider receipt and cost is present, official and strict judge parses are reported, and Naia exceeds the preregistered keyword-fallback control on overall accuracy without a lower abstention accuracy.
decision_rule.refute: Any protocol, custody, completeness, receipt, or label-isolation failure, or failure to beat the keyword-fallback control under the stated accuracy constraint.
decision_rule.superiority_boundary: Support establishes a protocol-matched Naia LongMemEval quality result only. It does not establish global SOTA or superiority over vendor-reported results produced with different prompts, models, cutoffs, corpora, or revisions.
